title: multi-az-dr-automation-terraform-helm
author: Aisha Kapoor
release_notes: Adds orchestrated multi-AZ failover and restore-drill automation: new Terraform module for AZ failover simulation, Helm chart for redwood-dr-operator, runbook-as-code playbooks and automated validation checks. Backwards compatible; default behavior disabled unless enabled in installer values.
description: Motivation: customers running Redwood Private requested a repeatable, auditable way to run restore drills across availability zones without manual playbooks. This PR introduces an orchestrated approach that ties a Terraform failover simulator, a Kubernetes operator (redwood-dr-operator) delivered via Helm, and runbook-as-code artifacts to make multi-AZ failovers and restore drills automated, observable, and reversible. Key components and design: 1) terraform/modules/az-failover: idempotent module that creates a small 'simulation' cluster in a separate management account/tenant and reusable IAM roles/credentials for controlled failover actions (route-table failover, instance detach, simulated link blackout). Module exposes outputs consumed by the installer to gate actions. 2) helm/charts/redwood-dr-operator: a light controller that reconciles RestoreDrill CRs, coordinates pod-level and node-level failover steps, and calls the Terraform simulation API via a Kubernetes Job. Operator supports dry-run, stage, execute, and rollback phases. 3) installer/runbooks/drill-orchestrator: runbook-as-code YAML that defines checklists, Slack hooks, PagerDuty escalation, and post-mortem artifact collection steps. 4) tests/acceptance/drill-sanity: end-to-end acceptance tests that spin up a minimal environment and run a dry-run drill. Checklist (in PR description): - [x] Terraform module implementation and docs - [x] Helm chart and operator deployment manifest - [x] RestoreDrill CRD and controller logic - [x] Runbook-as-code and example drills - [x] E2E dry-run tests and CI job - [x] Security review for IAM actions How it runs: operators install the Helm chart via installer values; operator watches RestoreDrill CRs and emits events to the console and Slack; when a RestoreDrill is executed the operator steps through precheck, stage (simulate traffic shift), execute (invoke Terraform simulation to toggle AZ connectivity), validate (traffic and token-level smoke checks), and rollback if validation fails. Rollback is implemented as automatic inverse actions plus a manual abort path. Tests and validation: CI runs DR acceptance suite under a mocked cloud provider; staging runs performed in our internal sandbox account with low blast radius. Observability: new metrics (dr_run_total, dr_phase_duration_seconds, dr_validation_failures) and trace hooks added to console so SREs can build dashboards. Security and safety: default installer values disable automated execution and require a dedicated service account with least-privilege IAM roles; all actions require a signed RestoreDrill CR with TTL and an audit entry. Backwards compatibility: installer will not enable controller unless values.enableDrillController=true. Rollout plan: merge to main, add feature flag to the private installer Helm values, run canary on two existing customer internal test deployments, and schedule a guided restore-drill for one internal site before recommending for customers. Related: closes ENG-4789 and SRE-102.

tests: add e2e drill-sanity test and CI job
review_comments: Daniel Cho: Left a few nits around controller retries and exponential backoff. Please add a circuit breaker so we don't loop against cloud API errors.
Aisha Kapoor: Addressed in controller patch: added jittered backoff and a failure budget counter with a hard stop after 5 retries. Added tests.
Rhea Patel: Can we make the terraform simulation module optional and document the operational prerequisites for on-prem? Also requested documentation for required IAM roles.
Aisha Kapoor: Added README section for on-prem: notes for engineers to provide an operator-only offline execution bundle. IAM least-privilege policy added to terraform/roles/README.
Omar Alami: CI acceptance test failed once on first run due to a flake in the mocked cloud provider; reran and green. Approving pending small docs fix.
Aisha Kapoor: Fixed docs typo and squashed commits as requested.
